edges.reason: Constructor derives the initial owner from _msgSender().
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the tokens.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance checks.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
manualswap is gated on the caller being _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend is gated on the caller being _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership requires the caller to equal the stored owner.
msg.sender is stored as _owner during construction.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
Cooldown mapping is written using block.timestamp.
Transfer cooldown comparison and enforcement depend on block.timestamp.
Router swap deadline is the current block.timestamp.
addLiquidityETH deadline argument is block.timestamp.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom decreases allowance through _approve.
balanceOf converts reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swap conditions hold.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee when contract ETH exists.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the redistribution fee.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call.
openTrading invokes the payable addLiquidityETH router call.
openTrading assigns the created pair address to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
_getValues fetches the current rate from _getRate.
_getValues reads _feeAddr1 as the redistribution fee rate.
_getValues reads _feeAddr2 as the team fee rate.
_getRate obtains supply values from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads the total reflection supply.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_takeTeam credits team reflections to _rOwned of the contract.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
balanceOf reads the reflection balance from _rOwned.
_transfer writes the cooldown timestamp for the recipient.
_transfer resets _feeAddr1 based on transfer direction.
_transfer resets _feeAddr2 based on transfer direction.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for both parties.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before auto swapping.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount on buys from the pair.
_transfer path leads to sendETHToFee which pushes ETH to fee wallets.
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to fee wallets.
Constructor initialises the _owner storage.
Constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee exempt.
Constructor sets the first fee wallet address.
Constructor sets the second fee wallet address.
Constructor mints the total reflection supply to the owner.
setBots writes the blacklist mapping under onlyOwner.
delBot clears a blacklist entry under onlyOwner.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldown flag under onlyOwner.
removeStrictTxLimit resets _maxTxAmount under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership overwrites _owner with the zero address.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth after the caller check.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee after the caller check.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the privileged address required by manualswap.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the contract ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the contract ETH.
uniswapV2Router is the external target used by swapTokensForEth.
swapTokensForEth queries the router for WETH and approves it.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate from _getRate.
External swap call can re-enter the transfer path via the pair and receive().
ETH transfer to a fee contract may execute a fallback that re-enters _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter is only meaningful as the destination of the ERC20 transfer function.
The amount parameter is consumed exclusively by the ERC20 transfer flow.
The sender parameter defines the debited account inside transferFrom.
The spender parameter is the approved address in the approve function.
The from parameter is the source account handled inside the internal _transfer.
The to parameter is the destination account handled inside the internal _transfer.
The token amount parameter directly feeds the external router swap call.
The bots array parameter is iterated and stored by setBots.
The notbot parameter is the address cleared from the blacklist by delBot.
The tAmount parameter is the input amount processed by _transferStandard.
The redistributionFee parameter configures the buy fee rate setter.
The marketingFee parameter configures the buy fee rate setter.
The onoff boolean parameter toggles the cooldown flag setter.
The account parameter is the address queried by balanceOf.
The local contract token balance is the amount forwarded to the swap.
The local current rate is produced by _getRate and consumed by callers.
The local team fee amount is the direct argument of _takeTeam.
